capabilities: Log strength sets with weight, reps, and optional RPE
Calculate volume and estimated 1RM (Epley formula) per set
Log cardio sessions with speed, incline, duration, and calorie estimates
Display progress charts in a dashboard sidebar view
Auto-create exercise notes with YAML frontmatter and autocomplete existing ones
extras: Not in the community plugin registry; must be built and installed manually from source. Supports English, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean UI.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log workout sessions as structured, queryable data.

relations.evidence: Install and enable the Dataview community plugin to query your workout data.

summary: Strength-training logger that records sets, cardio, and body metrics as Dataview-friendly note entries with a chart dashboard.
